description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans cluster health monitoring system, specifically testing the ClusterHealthMonitor and SiloHealthMonitor components. It sets up mock dependencies, simulates silo states, and verifies probe behaviors, silo status transitions, and death detection logic.

classes.name: ClusterHealthMonitorTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for Orleans' cluster health monitoring system, including scenarios for probing, silo state transitions, and death detection.

classes.name: ClusterHealthMonitorTestRig
classes.description: A helper class encapsulating dependencies and state for testing ClusterHealthMonitor.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_BasicScenario
methods.description: Runs a basic scenario test for ClusterHealthMonitor and SiloHealthMonitor with indirect probes enabled.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_MonitorAllStaleSilos
methods.description: Verifies that stale silos are monitored by all other silos.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_NoIndirectProbes
methods.description: Tests the basic operation without indirect probes.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_ThreeVotesNeededToKill
methods.description: Tests that three votes are required to declare a silo dead.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_OneVoteNeededToKill
methods.description: Tests that a single vote can declare a silo dead.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_SilosWithStaleCreatedOrJoiningState_OneVoteNeededToKill
methods.description: Tests death detection for silos in Created or Joining state with one vote needed.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_SilosWithStaleCreatedOrJoiningState_TwoVotesNeededToKill
methods.description: Tests death detection with two votes for silos in Created or Joining state.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_SilosWithStaleCreatedOrJoiningState_ThreeVotesNeededToKill
methods.description: Tests death detection with three votes for silos in Created or Joining state.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_SilosWithStaleCreatedOrJoiningState_Disabled
methods.description: Tests behavior when eviction for stale join or create states is disabled.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_BasicScenario_Runner
methods.description: Helper method executing a detailed scenario for cluster health monitoring with configurable options.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_StaleJoinOrCreatedSilos_Runner
methods.description: Helper method testing detection of stale join or created silos with configurable eviction.

methods.name: StopLifecycle
methods.description: Stops the lifecycle and cleans up timers and tasks.
